column1: # Pluribus pin annotation file — Great Scott Gadgets Cynthion r1.4
# SOURCE, and why this is safe to keep in-repo: Cynthion is open hardware.
# Extracted from the Amaranth platform definition, which is BSD-3-Clause:
# Per boards/README.md the rule is shareable-vs-not: this is a published pinout
# for open hardware, the same class of asset as a Ghidra processor definition.
# Deliberately PARTIAL.  This covers the pins a fabric self-test needs (#101) —
# a clock, a user button, LEDs for local convenience — not the full USB/PHY
# resource list.  A pinout claiming completeness it does not have is worse than
# one that states its scope.  Extend from the platform file as needed.

column4: 60 MHz oscillator — the fabric test clock
